changes.from: Maker spec table, DEX-M mobile configuration: 30.1 x 28.1 x 54.3 in (765 x 714 x 1,379 mm), 198 lb (89.8 kg), 11 lb (5 kg) payload per arm, 6 DOF per arm (12 total entered here; the maker states the per-arm figure only), 56 in wingspan, 4 depth cameras, modular end effectors, 1.2 m/s travel speed, 24 V 30 Ah battery (=720 Wh, derived), 3 h full charge, 35.4 in lift, two-wheel differential drive, LiDAR/depth/RGB/IMU/wheel-speed sensors, NVIDIA Jetson Thor.
